Oregon School Shooting Leaves 3 Children, Teacher Dead; Gunman Killed

A shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, resulted in the deaths of three children and one adult, identified as a teacher. The 16-year-old suspected gunman was also killed. Authorities stated the gunman died after being shot by a community member. The school was placed under lockdown during the incident.
